features.name: Peerless Athlete / Inspiring Smite
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you empower yourself (Athletics/Acrobatics, jumping) or, after a Divine Smite, you grant Temporary Hit Points to your allies.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.desc: Your Speed increases by 10 feet; allies within 10 feet gain +10 feet of Speed when they move.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.desc: As a Reaction, you give yourself or an ally a bonus to AC against an attack; if it misses, you make a retaliatory attack.

features.name: Living Legend
features.desc: As an action, for 1 minute: Advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn you can turn a miss into a hit, and once per turn you can reroll a saving throw.
